@@F /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    server_name _;
    return 444;
}
@@F /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/api-restaurant.example.com
server {
    server_name api-restaurant.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8081;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }

    listen 443 ssl; # managed by Certbot
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/api-restaurant.example.com/fullchain.pem; # managed by Certbot
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/api-restaurant.example.com/privkey.pem; # managed by Certbot
}
server {
    if ($host = api-restaurant.example.com) {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    } # managed by Certbot
    listen 80;
    server_name api-restaurant.example.com;
    return 404; # managed by Certbot
}
@@F /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/example.com
server {
    server_name restaurant.example.com www.example.com;
    # proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:9999;  eski yapılandırma
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080/;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
    }
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/;
    }
    listen 443 ssl;
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/restaurant.example.com/fullchain.pem;
}
